agent_changes.description: Certain Agent ability deployables can now be concussed.
Harbor now re-equips his gun faster after activating Cove
Added Buff Storm Surge now plays audio in world if enemies are hit
Max wall length increased from 50m to 60m
Added Can now re-use the ultimate to stop it in place for 7s.
*The ability description had incorrectly listed the duration at 3s while they were lasting 4s. The duration now accurately matches the description.
Overheal applied by Devour is now temporary and lasts 10s. Healing applied while in Empress is still permanent.
Adjusted the appearance of the Social Panel
UI damage indicators now display for objects that take damage while controlled by a player (i.e. Skye’s Trailblazer, Tejo’s Stealth Drone, etc)

bug_fixes: Cosmetics
A visual bug with the gold VFX trail on the Champions 2021 Karambit is now fixed!
Gameplay Systems
Fixed an issue where player names were misaligned in the Combat Report

Bugfix Hot Fixed a bug where players selected loadouts would reset in certain disconnect scenarios.
Bugfix Nerf Fixed a bug where certain Agents would drop Ult Orbs when they shouldn’t.
Bugfix Fixed an issue where glass breaking audio would play in an out of bounds area on Ascent. (wiki editor note: this was also mentioned in the 12.01 notes.)
Bugfix Fixed a bug where text would overrun on the Next Random Agent UI in certain localizations.
Agent
Fixed bugs where ability HUDs were missing in replays for Brimstone, Clove, Omen, and Tejo.
Bugfix Nerf Fixed a bug where Vyse's Shear was sometimes destroying Gekko’s Thrash, Skye’s Trailblazer, Sova’s Owl Drone, and Tejo’s Stealth Drone instead of pushing them aside.
Bugfix Nerf Fixed a bug where Cypher's Spycam dart could hit players in unexpected locations when going through the Bind teleporters
Bugfix Fixed a bug where Harbor’s Reckoning VFX indicator lines were not lined up with the hit box.
Bugfix Fixed a bug where Harbor’s Reckoning SFX would persist between rounds
Bugfix Buff Fixed a bug where in Team Deathmatch, Clove’s Pick-me-up overheal would sometimes not give health when Clove died previously with the buff active.
Bugfix Fixed a bug where Tejo’s Stealth Drone could ride on various projectiles.
Bugfix Fixed a bug for Coaches and Observers where Tejo’s Armageddon targeting cursor could go outside of the ability map UI.
Bugfix Fixed a bug for Coaches and Observers where Brimstone’s Sky Smoke and Orbital Strike map UI would not render when swapping to Brimstone’s perspective.
Bugfix Fixed a bug for Coaches and Observers where equipping Omen’s From the Shadows would cause the ability map UI to linger into the next round.
Bugfix Fixed a bug for Coaches and Observers where Agents with an ability map UI would repeatedly play their equip animation when switching to their POV.

Bugfix Fixed a bug where the ascender highlights could become permanently visible on a player if they tried to use both ascenders at once on Split.
player_behavior_changes: We made some tweaks to what shows up and when to make things more clear. You’ll no longer see an XP/AP Denial under Active Interventions when you leave a Deathmatch.
